content:
{
  "project": "agentic-knowledge-mapper",
  "what_building": "A risk assessment and knowledge mapping engine for multi-agent LLM debate systems. It generates structured risk registers by analyzing product briefs, model architectures, and potential failure modes like sycophancy or prompt injection.",
  "pipeline": [
    "ingest_brief",
    "map_architecture",
    "score_risk_tiers",
    "map_cve_attacks",
    "emit_register"
  ],
  "inputs": [
    "product_brief",
    "model_description",
    "risk_question",
    "cve_context"
  ],
  "outputs": [
    "risk_register",
    "exposure_tier_score",
    "failure_mode_map",
    "residual_risk_assessment"
  ],
  "confidence": 0.85,
  "evidence_quotes": [
    "Product: multi-agent debate systems (safety, robustness, and operational risks)",
    "Brief: Enumerate documented and hypothesized risks: sycophancy and conformity pressure among agents",
    "schema hints: ['brief', 'exposure tier', 'knowledge graph', 'misuse potential', 'model risk', 'residual risk', 'schema']",
    "heuristic guess: multi-agent debate risk scorer :: brief/product/model descriptors -> risk-scoring prompts (tiers 0-100, CVE/attack mapping) -> risk register"
  ]
}
